text:
Olivia: Hi team — I'm submitting my resignation today. Planning to make 2024-05-17 my last working day. Can someone kick off offboarding? Need clarity on benefits cutoff, COBRA timelines, how to return YubiKey + laptop, and when access will be revoked.
Marcus: Thanks for the heads up, Olivia. We'll coordinate coverage. Please put a short list of active projects and two handoff slots in a doc. Onsite needed?
Olivia: I'll be remote but can travel to SF office if needed for dropoff. Prefer to ship the laptop. Asset tag is RDN-04012.
Ada (People Ops): Sorry to see you go. Quick answers:
- Benefits end: coverage terminates end-of-day on your last date (2024-05-17).
- COBRA: packet goes out within 14 business days after coverage end. You usually have 60 days to elect from the notice date; first premium can be retroactive to 2024-05-18.
- Final pay + accrued PTO: processed on next payroll cycle; HR will email timeline.
- Exit interview: we can schedule 30 min the week after your last day — morning preferred?
Olivia: Mornings work. Also question: if I elect COBRA late, is there a gap in coverage?
Ada (People Ops): COBRA is retroactive to the coverage end date if elected within the election window, so there shouldn't be a coverage gap once elected, but payments must be timely. The packet contains carrier contacts and premium amounts.
IT-bot: Please confirm full asset info to generate return label. We'll flag device for wipe on the business day after last active day unless manager requests earlier.
```
asset_tag: RDN-04012
serial: SN-9Z1L2
device: MacBook Pro 14"
```
Marcus: Can you draft two 20-min walkthrough notes for the ownership items? We'll set up the handoff meetings. Also flag any infra secrets you know about. @Security will do an audit.
Security: We'll run access reviews the morning after 2024-05-17 at 09:00 PT. Please ensure no personal credentials stored in repos. We'll revoke SSO and org-level keys after the audit.
Olivia: I have a personal YubiKey and a company one. I'll return the company YubiKey. Where to drop?
Ada (People Ops): You can use SF asset locker or request a prepaid UPS label. I'll DM the locker code and send the label if you prefer shipping. Please mark the YubiKey for return in the asset form.
Marcus: Heads up: if there are long-lived deploy keys, we'll rotate them before deprovision, schedule TBD.
Olivia: I'll remove personal tokens and push a small README explaining the runbooks today.
Ada (People Ops): Exit interview scheduled 2024-05-20 10:00 PT; Calendly invite sent. COBRA packet will be mailed and emailed within 14 business days after 5/17. Final payroll and asset-return instructions sent via email. If immediate access concerns, ping @Security or me. Thanks, Olivia.
Olivia: Thanks everyone for helping make this smooth.
Marcus: Appreciate it — we'll get the handoffs on calendar. :thumbsup:
